text:
Maya CSM: Heads up — Greenlane (midmarket) showing ~30% drop in weekly active feature usage. Renewal in 14 days, risk score moved to HIGH. Proposing a short churn-prevent play: micro-enable sessions + a downgrade-hold option + feedback sprint.

Sanjay CS: thx Maya. what's the primary metric dip? embeddings calls or general token volume?

Maya CSM: embeddings volume down 40% and support tickets spiked for model output quality (mostly hallucinations on invoice-parsing). No billing disputes yet.

Derek Solutions: I can do a targeted enablement session focused on prompt patterns and schema enforcement. Recommend 3x30-min slots next week.

Jia PM: agree on sessions. Also: consider a temporary "grace hold" on downgrade that keeps current pricing for 30 days if they opt into the enablement + feedback loop. helps reduce churn while we fix QoL.

Maya CSM: proposed quick plan: 1) Offer 3 micro-sessions (enablement lab) + one async config review. 2) If they accept, enable 30-day downgrade-hold and optional 10% goodwill credit for onboarding work. 3) Capture structured feedback via short survey + 1-on-1 NPS follow-up. 4) If no acceptance in 72h, kick to standard downgrade-path.

Sanjay CS: sign me up for running the async config review. who owns the credit approval?

Derek Solutions: credit needs CS lead + finance approval. suggest templated ask to finance:```
Subject: Greenlane goodwill credit request
Account: Greenlane
Reason: onboarding enablement + short-term retention
Amount: USD 1,200 (10% credit)
Duration: applied to next invoice if enablement completed
```

Maya CSM: will drop the email to finance once we get account OK. also adding suggested enablement agenda: ```
- 10m: quick account recap + pain check
- 10m: prompt patterns + schema fixes for invoice parsing
- 10m: quick test + followup actions
```

Jia PM: we should also capture two targeted eval prompts for regression monitoring. Add to the enablement deliverables and tag eng-research.

Maya CSM: assigned tasks: @Sanjay CS - lead outreach + calendar slots; @Derek Solutions - run enablement labs; @Jia PM - compile regression prompts + own feedback survey; Maya CSM - submit credit request and own renewal handoff.

OnboardBot: Reminder: create "Greenlane enablement" support ticket and attach agenda.

Sanjay CS: outreach message ready, short version below — want to run it by team: ```Hi Team — we noticed activity drop and have a short enablement + options to avoid immediate downgrade. Would you be open to 3 x 30min labs next week? If yes we can also apply a 30-day downgrade-hold and a small credit for enablement work.```

Maya CSM: LGTM. small tweak: add "we'll share regression tests and action items".

Derek Solutions: i'll prepare a one-page checklist for the lab and a couple of quick config fixes we can push if approved.

Jia PM: i'll draft the 3-question post-session survey (ease-of-use, quality, confidence) and add the eval prompts.

Maya CSM: timeline: outreach within 24h, sessions scheduled within 7 days, finance request same day as acceptance. fallback: if they decline enablement or hold, escalate to standard downgrade-path and CSM to prepare renewal offer.

Sanjay CS: noted. I'll ping once calendar fills. :thumbsup:

Maya CSM: thanks team — keeping this thread as the single source of truth for the play. I'll update with finance reply and session notes.
